# EntityYaw

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Entities](Blitz3D-Entities)

```blitzbasic
EntityYaw entity%, global%=0  ; returns Float
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Reads the rotation around Y in degrees.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | Int | required | Entity handle. |
| `global` | Int | `0` | 1 for the angle in the world. Defaults to 0. |

**Returns:** Yaw angle of the entity, relative to its parent or with `global` set to 1 in the world.
